issue.title: etcdserver: use context for Renew

repository.name: etcd
repository.description: Distributed reliable key-value store for the most critical data of a distributed system

issue.body:
Renew would retry a few times before returning a not primary error that
the client should never see. Instead, use proper timeouts and
then return a request timeout error on failure.

Fixes #6922

body:
> . I'll provide a case to reproduce soon.

Ideally a test case?
@xiang90 I'll provide a small reproducer, but I'm not familiar with etcd tests, thus it may take time to do it properly as a test case.
I think this can be reproduced by closing the lease interface and trying to open a new keepalive channel.

@heyitsanthony Correct. But we also have a case for two-node cluster that will kill `recvKeepAliveLoop` while keeping client alive. In both cases I think client should be fixed to close channel always, or return an error, as in my quick-fix. In other cases it will cause deadlock in client code.
Wouldn't it be the same path? The lease interface is closed iff donec is closed. If the keepalive loop gets a halting error, donec is closed so the interface is effectively closed as well.
@heyitsanthony Sure, it's the same code path for deadlock. I'm just trying to say that there is a second bug with that loop.
